title: Error Handling
theory:
> **Curriculum:** This chapter follows [LEARN-LANGUAGES/CURRICULUM.md](../../CURRICULUM.md). Exercise ids are shared across LEARN-* repos for cross-reference.

## Errors

Use exceptions for exceptional paths; **`try`/`catch`**, custom exception types, and `when` filters.

exercises.title: Return Result
exercises.description: `divide` returning `Err` on zero; handle and print `Error: division by zero`.

exercises.title: Not-found Result
exercises.description: `find_user` returns `Err` unless name is `alice`; on `bob` print `User not found`.

exercises.title: Map error
exercises.description: Wrap a base error string with prefix using `map_err`.

exercises.title: Downcast-style field
exercises.description: Return `ValidationError { field: email }` as `Box<dyn std::error::Error>`; print field.

exercises.title: Inspect chain
exercises.description: Print formatted error then `Disk is full` if message contains `disk full`.
exercises.expected_output:
reading data.txt: disk full
Disk is full
exercises.solution:
Console.Write(@"reading data.txt: disk full
Disk is full");
